goal: Storage and iOS root: read the phone's own storage, then mount an iOS root read-only.

criteria.requirement: NativeSdhci performs one real read on the handset: card initialisation, clock, bus width and a PIO read of at least one block, with the controller state logged.
criteria.note: Host tests and an ABI compile exist; no XNU read path has run on the phone. The archive is not even in the kernel image yet: NativeSdhci subclasses IOBlockStorageDevice, which lives in IOStorageFamily and only exists after the prelink merge, so the source link cannot resolve it (board.toml [kernel.link_excluded]). Linking it needs the driver emitted as a kext bundle and merged by the prelink step, which is P2 work.

criteria.requirement: The real GPT is enumerated read-only and backed up to independent media, and a restore from that backup has been rehearsed once (install -> boot -> restore -> Windows boots again).
criteria.note: The backup half exists in scripts/install-native-bringup.py, and --restore now puts the recorded EFIESP files back (archive checked against before.json first, install-created files removed, final readback) with host tests on both branches. What is still missing is the rehearsal: install -> boot -> restore -> Windows boots again needs the phone.

criteria.requirement: XNU mounts the iOS root read-only and reaches launchd, with the mount and the launchd start in the same record.
criteria.note: Depends on P1 exiting and on the Data volume question being answered explicitly (see P4.3).
